## Why visit

A compact railway-arch stop that adds another producer to a Piccadilly brewery afternoon without a separate journey. The taproom is beside the brewery, and the documented cask lines make it relevant to this brief as well as to fans of modern pales and stronger keg beer. Its main advantage is the direct producer setting and easy combination with Balance, Track and Cloudwater. Use it as a selective extra based on the live board; the nearby cluster is more rewarding with time to compare than with an obligation to visit every venue.

## Plan the visit

Current official page closes Monday and Tuesday. Friday opening differs from CAMRA, so check directly. Ordinary visits do not need table bookings according to the operator.

**Getting there:** Walk from Manchester Piccadilly; pair with Balance.
